'''March 2000 Cincinnati tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Cincinnati, OH in March 2000. [[Frank Lamantia]] won it. It is known from Frank Lamantia's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d355">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-18-cincinatti-ohio-3-21-00d355/ cincinatti-ohio-3-21-00], DeckTech (Frank "FrankLamanti" Lamantia, 18 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-18-cincinatti-ohio-3-21-00d355/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' March 2000
* '''Site:''' Cincinnati, OH
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 15
* '''Winner:''' [[Frank Lamantia]]
